title: SHORT REBIND CALLOUT, QUIETER SETTINGS DETAIL PANE
why: Critic c-31 round 11 (Pad buttons 75 at 2, Settings 18 and 72 at 3): the rebind banner is an explaining sentence at 14px with clipped corners; the Settings detail pane repeats the focused row title and value. One short callout at 20px, and a pane that shows only the help line.
now: Rebind callout is one short line, Settings detail pane shows only the help text.
